cohort: The study participants were 42 pregnant women positive for COVID-19 who were admitted to Hokkaido University Hospital from September 2020 to June 2021.
finding: The need for medical intervention in pregnant patients with SARS-CoV2 infection can be predicted with high accuracy using a C-reactive protein (CRP) cutoff of 1.28 mg/dL on days 4-6 after onset of syndromes, with fever also serving as an easy marker.
